reviews.t: BEAUTIFUL BUT VERRYYY LONG AND THICK.
reviews.x: Beautiful wig but very very long. When I read other reviews that said they would cut it I was like why??? But now I understand. Although the length is nice it's extreme. I am 5'7 and it is down to the top of my butt and extremely thick. It's a little hard to do simple tasks with this on. But the color is gorgeous mixed with peaches lavenders and pastel pinks. Gets tangled extremely easy. If you don't mind any of that then I recommend this wig.

I’ve had this wig for a couple months now and so far I’ve had absolutely no problems. The wig overall has a coral color, with strands of lilac and orange mixed in, which is gorgeous. The hairline looks natural, it is a lace front, and the hair is pretty thick. I can part the wig however I want without seeing any of the lace. If you are thinking about getting this wig, go for it. It’s an amazing wig.

I was super unsure about this wig when ordering it BUT I am soooooo in love the hair line is invisible and not thick the quality of hair is amazing I freaking love this wig the pastel pink is sooo cute has stands of purple in it I’m just soooo in love with this wig it holds wig glue well to it styles easy it just incredibly impressed with this wig 10/10 would recommend

BITCH. This is cuuuute. I didn’t pluck the hairline or anything and it looks so good. The only thing is the sideburn parts wouldn’t really stick down but I think that’s because my natural sideburns are pretty thick so I’m just gonna wax then a bit before the next time I wear it🙃 the length is amazing. Doesn’t tangle too bad. Easy to style. But it.

This was my very first wig purchase and I couldn’t be happier! The color is exactly as pictured, the hair has a nice thickness, minimal shedding and has a natural looking hairline. The parts a little hard to play with and it definitely looked synthetic but after some cutting, thinning out & powdering it was perfect!
I love this wig! Thick, soft hair. I'm not crazy about the part in the middle but I was able to adjust it a little bit to the side so it gave more of a side part look! Very well made!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the color, describing it as a beautiful peachy/coral pink with mixed tones like lilac, orange, and blue.
Many reviewers note the wig is very long and thick, with several recommending cutting it.
Tangling is a commonly mentioned drawback, though some say a quick brush or dry shampoo helps.
Reviewers often mention receiving frequent compliments and finding the hairline and shine look natural.
A few reviewers report negative issues such as a fake look, poor fit, or faulty sections.
